author: DoDar
quote:
Such a let down. The one game that is the leading seller of the industry has gone woke, and they will pay the price. Terrible, terrible writing, and even worse gameplay? How could they think it was a good idea to throw out the window the one selling point they had for GTA; 'unfiltered', 'unhinged'. both of which are now sadly gone. It lacks freedom to break rules, a fundamental element of GTA that made it popular, and it lacks a depth of dark humour which also played a part in the success of the franchise.

This isn't just a "flop" its an assassination of a brand, a controlled demolition **** universe we all loved!
